title: PaperOrchestra writing (native TS/Pi, PlotOff)
description: Run the PaperOrchestra writing pipeline with BrainPilot's enabled paper library and Tavily search: outline, source-supported literature discovery and verification, section writing, automatic scored content refinement, and one formatting pass, producing editable LaTeX and a compiled PDF.
applicableWhen: The user requests a complete research manuscript from supplied methodology and experimental results, a LaTeX template and venue guidelines.
The current host and PI model can compile LaTeX, extract PDF text, inspect rendered page images, and access source-supported scholarly metadata through the enabled paper library or Tavily tools.
notApplicableWhen: Ordinary questions, workflow explanations, short reports, local edits, or discussions that do not request executing a complete manuscript workflow.
Missing required research materials or requesting fabrication of experiments/results.
Generating new plots or diagrams: this implementation restores the upstream default PlotOff path.

research_cutoff.description: Exclusive publication cutoff at the first day of YYYY-MM. To include an entire month, pass the following month; for example, 2025-06 includes May 2025 and excludes publications on or after June 1, 2025. Records need a known publication year; same-year records with only a year cannot establish that they precede this cutoff.
